090 | DONE   | Music Library: duplicate event listeners accumulate on re-rendered file grids. renderFiles() in members/music.html attaches a delegated click listener on .file-grid each time it is called. renderFiles() is invoked both on initial accordion expand and again on the post-upload re-render path. Each re-render adds a second (third, nth) listener to the same element without removing the prior one. Net effect: a member who uploads a photo and then clicks a download link in a song panel that was open during the upload will fire the handler multiple times — triggering duplicate downloads staggered at 400ms each. Fix: Detach the existing listener before attaching, or attach once outside renderFiles() using event delegation scoped to the song panel container. File: members/music.html. Priority: Low — requires upload + open panel simultaneously; no data loss; cosmetic/UX annoyance only. Fixed 2026-07-20: removed the grid-level delegated .file-download-link listener entirely; PDF "Open" rows now bind a direct click listener in setNormal() (matching the #095 direct-listener pattern for audio rows), so no listener can accumulate on re-render.

Music Library is currently not the first link, meaning iPhone users must scroll horizontally (or see a truncated nav) to find it. Music Library is the primary use case for mobile members (learning tracks). Reorder the nav link list in all member portal pages to place Music Library first. Priority: Medium — directly impacts the primary mobile workflow.

092 | DONE   | Music Library: Recently Played compact view on mobile. Add a "Recently Played" section to members/music.html, visible on all viewports but designed primarily for mobile. Shows the last 3 learning tracks played (audio files only, not PDFs), most recent first. Collapsed by default showing a single summary line ("Recently Played · 3 tracks"); taps to expand showing the track list. Clicking any track in the list invokes the player directly (cache hit path — all recently played tracks are by definition cached). Data source: The localStorage cache queue (pdt-music-cache-queue). Queue entries must therefore store display metadata in addition to fileId and modifiedTime: songName (folder name), trackName (file name, display-formatted), and playedAt (timestamp for ordering). Display only the 3 most recent. If queue is empty, section is hidden. Placement: Top of the music page content area, above the song accordion, below the voice-pill header. Collapsed height should be one line so it doesn't compete with the song list on a small screen. Cache queue entry shape: { fileId: string, modifiedTime: string (ISO; cache key component + staleness check), songName: string (folder name, for Recently Played display), trackName: string (filename display-formatted, extension stripped), playedAt: number (Date.now() at time of play, for sort order) }. Priority: Medium — nice-to-have for mobile UX; implementation depends on the Music Library audio player being built first (player issue not yet filed — no issue number assigned as of 2026-07-20). Fixed 2026-07-20 (after #095): #recently-played section renders as first child of .music-content > .container (outside #library-content, so it shows instantly from localStorage independent of the Drive listing). Top 3 queue entries by playedAt desc; collapsed toggle "Recently Played · N track(s)"; taps expand; each track's ▶ calls the shared playTrack(). Two spec refinements folded in: (1) queue entry now stores filename (see pdt-decisions.md amendment) so queue-sourced plays have a correct download URL; (2) same-tab refresh — renderRecentlyPlayed() runs after pushToQueue (not only on the storage event, which never fires in the writing tab), guarded to skip rebuild while an RP-injected <audio> is active so it is never destroyed mid-play. data-play-container generalizes playTrack()'s injection target across .file-row and .rp-track. All CSS inline in music.html.

094 | DONE   | Music Library: add modifiedTime to the Drive file listing fields — prerequisite for track caching. The localStorage cache queue design (#092) keys cache entries on modifiedTime, using it as both a cache key component and the staleness check. That field is not currently returned by the listing API, so the caching design cannot be implemented as specced until this lands. As-built: listFiles() in netlify/functions/drive-music.js requests fields=files(id,name,mimeType) and returns Drive's array verbatim with no reshaping — so the client receives id, name, and mimeType only. Change to fields=files(id,name,mimeType,modifiedTime). Second location: the IS_LOCAL branch of fetchFiles() in members/music.html builds its own direct Drive query with the same fields=files(id,name,mimeType) list; it must be updated identically or local dev will diverge from production and the cache will silently misbehave when tested locally. Not affected and deliberately out of scope: listFolders() (fields=files(id,name)) — folders carry no cached content; sunburst-list and carousel-list actions — neither participates in track caching. Note Drive returns modifiedTime as an RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 string, matching the string type in the #092 queue entry shape. Priority: Medium — blocks #092 and the audio player; small, low-risk change (additive field, no consumer breaks since existing code ignores unknown fields). Files: netlify/functions/drive-music.js, members/music.html. Fixed 2026-07-20: modifiedTime added to listFiles() fields in drive-music.js and to the IS_LOCAL branch of fetchFiles() in music.html.

095 | DONE   | Music Library: audio player with Cache API (resolves iOS/Android MP3 download UX). Background: On mobile browsers (iOS Safari and Android Chrome), the current fetch → blob → <a download> pattern for learning tracks either triggers an app-picker (iOS) or saves a file to device (Android) rather than playing the audio. This issue covers the full audio player feature that replaces download-only behavior. Scope: (1) drive-music.js — prerequisite: add modifiedTime to listFiles() fields param (#094); must land first. (2) members/music.html — Play button: Replace per-row a.file-download-link with a ▶ button on audio (MP3) rows only. PDFs unchanged ("Open" link stays). Bulk download buttons (div.download-actions) hidden on mobile via CSS (tracked decision, #093). (3) members/music.html — Desktop ⋮ menu: Alongside the Play button on all viewports, a secondary ⋮ menu containing "Download" which calls existing proxyDownload(). Download for all authenticated members on desktop; hidden on mobile. (4) members/music.html — Playback: Native <audio controls> element, injected into the row on Play click. Single shared <audio> instance — clicking Play on a second track stops the first. src fed from blob URL constructed from cache hit or fresh stream. (5) members/music.html — Cache API: Cache name pdt-music-v1. Cache key: synthetic URL https://pdt-music-cache/${fileId}/${modifiedTime}. On Play: check cache → HIT: serve blob, no network → MISS: fetch Edge Function → clone Response → store clone → feed original to <audio>. FIFO queue in localStorage key pdt-music-cache-queue, capped at 10 entries. Queue entry shape: { fileId, modifiedTime, songName, trackName, playedAt }. (6) members/music.html — Stale-key cleanup: On page load, after the listing arrives, iterate the queue and delete any cache entry whose modifiedTime doesn't match the current listing value for that fileId. This catches director track updates automatically. (7) members/music.html — Recently Played: Implementation depends on this issue being complete first (per #092). Platforms: Mobile (iOS Safari, Android Chrome) and desktop. Native <audio controls> renders appropriately on all. Future work (not in scope): Custom playback controls UI (loop toggle, progress scrubber, track label, Play/Pause button) to replace native <audio controls> chrome — to be filed as a separate issue once the player is live. Blocking: #094 must be closed first. Blocks #092. Files: members/music.html, netlify/functions/drive-music.js (via #094), css/main.css (mobile bulk-button hide). Priority: High — resolves core mobile member workflow failure. Fixed 2026-07-20: Play button (▶/⏸) replaces download link on MP3 rows across all viewports; native <audio controls> injected below the row; single shared audio instance. Cache API pdt-music-v1 keyed on fileId+modifiedTime, FIFO localStorage queue (pdt-music-cache-queue, cap 10, Option A re-play bump), stale-key cleanup on panel open. Desktop ⋮ menu exposes Download via proxyDownload(); ⋮ menu and .download-actions hidden below 600px. All player CSS added inline to members/music.html (not css/main.css — kept with existing Music Library styles). No IS_LOCAL branch in the player (always Cache API path). #090 duplicate-listener bug not addressed here.
